transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Hi Priya, can you see me okay? Let's start with your neck.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, good. The neck is about 3 out of 10 today, better than last week's 6.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: The headaches are gone since I changed my monitor height.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: My right hand felt numb once on Monday when I was typing. Only once.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Thanks for telling me. Did it come back?

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Are you doing the chin tucks and the doorway stretch?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Chin tucks every morning. Doorway stretch maybe twice a week.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: I'll ask you to turn your head to each side while I watch on camera. The left looks about like last week. The right looks a bit more limited.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: I can't measure it accurately over video, so I'll check it in person.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay. I'm also getting back to the gym. Is that fine?

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Light gym work is fine. Avoid heavy overhead pressing for now.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Plan: keep the morning chin tucks, add a wall stretch, and come in for an in-person visit next Thursday.

expectedFacts.statement: Neck pain about 3 out of 10, down from 6
Headaches gone after monitor height change
Right hand went numb once on Monday
Right rotation looks more limited on video
Avoid heavy overhead pressing for now
